profile.summary: Evonile Pharma Limited is involved in the pharmaceutical business in India. The company offers therapeutic products in the areas of bone and pain under the Voveran brand; transplantation immunology under the Simulect, Certican, Sandimmun, Neoral, and Myfortic brands. It also offers neuroscience products under the Tegrital and Exelon brands. The company was formerly known as Novartis India Limited
